verdict: Paid campaigns have been dark 12 days; reactivation is the priority.
narrative: Meta advertising stopped running on August 6th and has delivered zero spend and zero paid leads since — the cause is being addressed and campaigns are being reactivated now. Over the full 28-day window you received 45 leads at $26.04 per lead, all earned before the pause. Your Google Business Profile held steady through most of that stretch, generating 161 actions and 55 calls this period, but GBP engagement also softened in the last 7 days, so organic alone is not a substitute. Separately, 33 contacts entered your pipeline this period but none have moved to a confirmed opportunity, so intake follow-up is being reviewed in parallel. Once paid activity resumes, the cost-per-lead target is well-established and the prior active period gives a clear baseline to match against.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from the active paid window before August 6th
calls driven by your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days
cost per lead over the 28-day window — a confirmed baseline to hold on reactivation

watch_item.issue: Meta campaigns have been offline for 12 days, cutting paid lead flow to zero.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reactivated this week, with budget and targeting aligned to the pre-pause cost-per-lead baseline.
